messages.author: Alan
messages.body:
Hi
I was reviewing some old code and I came across a routine using "sleap"
instead of "tleap". What happened to it? Which version it got dropped? It's
just curiosity and then I will remove any reference to it in my code.
I'm using ambertools 19.
Thanks in advance,
-- 
Alan Silva

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Nov 14, 2021, Alan wrote:
>
>I was reviewing some old code and I came across a routine using "sleap"
>instead of "tleap". What happened to it? Which version it got dropped? It's
>just curiosity and then I will remove any reference to it in my code.
It was dropped around 2013: present in Amber12 but not in Amber14. It
basically was a too-ambitious effort that had only one developer to support
it.
....dac

messages.author: Alan
messages.body:
Thanks David, time to dish it here in code as well.
Best,
Alan
